notes: Pink pepper, lemon, artemisia; jasmine, iris, black tea; guaiac wood, patchouli, nagarmotha. Accords: white floral, citrus, tea, powdery, woody.
impressions: Full bottle received 10/22/2026. Beautiful black tea note, which I'll probably pick up more when I wear it without a bunch of other stuff on. Really fresh and wonderful; I can see why Acqua di Parma is a classic.

notes: Tobacco, burnt sugar, birch tar, dates, tonka, labdanum, cacao, vanilla, Peru balsam, beeswax.
impressions: Full bottle received October 12, 2026. It is amazing. It is beastly and lives on through the day. Sweet cigar smell gives way to the honey and vanilla in the drydown. I feel like I am at Café Tabac for a fun evening.

notes: Fruity, salty aquatic (per 10/13 skin impression).
impressions:
Tested at Ameer 10/13/2026: very nice, cool fruit against saltwater.
10/22/2026: Full bottle received. It was on my reinvestigate tier and very inexpensive online, so a low-risk buy, and not really blind since I'd tried it. I like it; I don't know if I love it like the others, but it's quite good. Slightly fruitier and not as sweet as I remembered; I imagine it gets a little sweeter on the drydown.

notes: Cardamom, turmeric, pink pepper; jasmine sambac, solar notes, rose; ambergris, frankincense/olibanum, sandalwood.
impressions: Overall: I am getting ocean but with a bit of a dense floral overlay that blankets the spice notes. Drydown gives me more wood. Floral with depth and intrigue, not too cloying. I think it may be too dense to layer.

notes: Frankincense, bergamot, myrrh, juniper, Atlas cedar, vanilla.
impressions:
Overall: Bought the travel size and love it. Full bottle remains on the wishlist. Stunning; has some of Guidance's fruity DNA but is less loud and has a clean fruit lift.
Wear evolution: Very fruity, bright lift; Guidance-family resemblance but quieter. → Remained beautiful enough to buy the travel size.

notes: Pear, hazelnut, frankincense; osmanthus, rose, saffron, jasmine sambac; sandalwood, vanilla, Akigalawood, ambergris, labdanum.
impressions: Overall: A loud fruity, nutty open but it sucks you in; it really takes over the bubble around you; wood and spice notes are brilliant under this. I get the vanilla too, which softens it but this is not really gourmand. Gourmand-adjacent. The drydown, all of it really works. Big love.

notes: Rose water, pear, hazelnut, bitter almond, frankincense, pink pepper; rose, osmanthus, saffron, jasmine sambac; sandalwood, Akigalawood, vanilla, ambrette, ambergris, labdanum, Georgywood, cypriol.
impressions: Overall: See Guidance but more nutty and gentler since it is extrait. I love it and could layer it. It's a calmer version of the Big Bold Guidance but drydowns are similar. It may be too gentle without a regular Guidance push.

notes: Sichuan pepper, ginger, Peruvian pepper, saffron; frankincense/olibanum, myrrh, fenugreek; labdanum, benzoin, vetiver, patchouli.
impressions: Overall: My favorite signature scent at this time. Mineral, but with wood depth. The pepper is a beautiful open. Unusual for Amouage, gorgeous with an oud resin layer underneath. Very wearable I think of the ocean, of a spa, of temples. Incense plus aquatic. This is the fragrance that really launched the current exploration; despite all the new sampling, it remains a high-water mark for me.

notes: Brandy, apple, saffron, bergamot; benzoin, myrrh, cinnamon, rose, geranium; leather, frankincense/olibanum, labdanum.
impressions: Overall: I like it enough and fell compelled to use it but that beery-hoppy open is not my favorite. Cinnamon is part of the issue too. It calms down nicely and works well enough on my skin but this taught me that boozy might be a risky bet. Could possibly be layered.

notes: op notes are Olibanum, elemi and Ink; middle notes are Rose Water, Olibanum and Suede; base notes are Myrhh, Sandalwood, Vanilla and Cedar.
impressions: Overall: got it in the travel size with Decision just to try it

notes: Galbanum, clove, cedar, oakmoss, vanilla. Dark green, mossy, woody, earthy/bitter.
impressions:
Purchased 10/3/2026 after successful skin test. Green → herbal/spicy, lightly witchy; evolves beautifully and feels fully wearable. Purchase decision complete.
10/8/2026 owner confirmation: Coven is owned and fantastic; a benchmark for distinctive green perfumery, not a prospective purchase.

notes: Hinoki, pear, pepper, iris, ambrette, incense, moss, rice-bran absolute.
impressions:
Full bottle purchased via Facebook group/Marketplace; shipped or shipping as of October 12, 2026. Low projection was noted in prior sampling. A great sleepytime or gym frag.
10/22/2026: Full bottle received. It's going to be a beautiful sleepytime, light or gym fragrance. It has an Asian-style nuttiness and is so nicely blended; like ELOREA, it echoes the lighter Asian-style fragrances.

notes: Turkish rose; sandalwood, saffron; Indian oud, amber.
impressions: Overall: Yes to the saffron with some floral and wood notes. Lovely alone or as a base for minerals/lighter. Saffron note is quite prominent and that's a-ok! Very Gulf.

notes: Chocolate, rose petals, saffron, woody/oud character, vanilla; warm spicy, sweet, rosy and leathery facets.
impressions:
Overall: Sharper spicy woody open with chocolate popping out but not too sweet. Could be polarizing but I find it intriguing and beautiful. It is STATEMENT. Much like NY Oud, I am coming out loud and proud when I wear that. Great for a cooler day; this doesn't say summer to me.
Wear evolution: Sharp opener and chocolate both mellow with wear, but the chocolate never turns into baked-goods/gourmand territory. Becomes even more beautiful and distinctive through the day.
Performance: Strong longevity; hangs around and continues to evolve/cook through the day.

notes: Saffron; rose, musk; patchouli, oud, amber. On skin the saffron/patchouli/wood structure reads dry, spicy, resinous and slightly camphoraceous.
impressions:
Overall: Skin test 9/24/2026 at Arabian Oud. A real beauty and a clear winner. Sweet, but the sweetness never takes over: the fragrance stayed sharp, resinous and slightly camphoraceous on skin. The drydown gained definition rather than smoothing into a generic rose-amber oud, and I kept returning to my wrist. Recheck 9/25 confirmed the purchase: still the Arabian Oud winner for me. Compared directly with Oud for Greatness, Saffron Oud's finish has more punch and the sharpness I prefer.
Wear evolution: Beautiful saffron-led opening: warm and sweet, but already carrying a dry spicy edge. → Sharpened as it dried down. Resinous/camphoraceous bite stayed alive over the warmer oud-amber base; unlike Resala, no chocolate effect. Confirmed sharper and more distinctive than Oud for Greatness in the late drydown.
Performance: Full skin wear stayed compelling through the drydown; strong enough to retain character and contrast.

notes: Warm traditional shamama spices; charila/lichen; choya smoke; sandalwood base.
impressions: Overall: Traditional Kannauj shamama — same warm spice-smoke architecture as Shamamatul Amber 2000, with charila and choya smoke in the base. Already purchased, not yet tested.

notes: Clove, cinnamon, cardamom, nutmeg; roasted cypriol, spikenard and valerian roots; sandalwood; rose, jasmine, saffron; amber.
impressions: Overall: Traditional Kannauj-style shamama with amber — clove, cinnamon, cardamom and nutmeg over roasted cypriol, spikenard and valerian roots, sandalwood base, rose/jasmine/saffron lift.

notes: Top notes are hyacinth and pineapple; middle notes are jasmine, iris and pink pepper; base notes are amber, musk, vanilla, patchouli and vetiver.
impressions: BLIND BUY based on my liking for this house's DNA. Full bottle purchased through Mercari and received October 20, 2026. Not yet evaluated on skin.

notes: Raspberry, mixed berries, pink pepper; saffron, osmanthus, jasmine, rose; tobacco, amber, musk, labdanum.
impressions:
Overall: Purchased 9/20/2026. The boozy-looking opening resolves quickly into a much more interesting wood/fruit/smoke structure; the development was compelling enough to buy.
Wear evolution: Bright dark-fruit opening with a boozy impression. → Turns woody, smoky and fruit-laced rather than gourmand.
Performance: Full wear after purchase actually amazing

notes: Peach blossom, bergamot; tuberose, gardenia, orange blossom, peony; cardamom, vanilla, sandalwood, guaiac wood, patchouli, cedar.
impressions: Overall: I like the spicy oriental floral take on this a lot. It's got fruit and wood too. It really lasts for a while and is a lovely counterpoint to other things I have. No oud! But arresting. Slightly heavy for summer but you can get away with it. I think it is very wearble, even to the office.

notes: Petitgrain, bergamot, grapefruit, green/watery notes, mandarin; neroli, lemon verbena, basil, jasmine, gardenia, lily, cyclamen; oakmoss, vetiver, musk, white woods.
impressions: Overall: More dude. I liked it in the beginning but it feels more manly now than I want to take on.

notes: Plum, saffron, orange; rose, agarwood (oud), patchouli, orris; musk, white honey, vetiver.
impressions:
Overall: I actually really love this. The open screams and slaps you around but then it settles down rich and wood and rose. Just amazing in the middle and drydown. Also STATEMENT--sharp open like Resala but even more so. Very much a cold weather wear.
10/8/2026 owner reflection: New York Oud is gloriously obnoxious and amazing; dramatic, forceful opening evolves into a captivating wear. Already owned.

notes: Orris, carrot, cardamom; sandalwood, fig, papyrus; amber, musk, oakmoss.
impressions: Overall: I enjoy this, it is a solid sandalwood blend but I can be a bit bored. Might try to mix and layer for entertainment.

notes: Sweet orange, petitgrain, cassis; orange blossom, jasmine, orris; moss, cedar, vetiver, amber.
impressions: Overall: This is very unisex and bright and sharp and very wearable like Insolent. It's deffo got green in it but florals that are proximate, well blended, not cloying. All weather.

notes: Top notes are Cherry Communion Wine and Cinnamon Leaf; middle notes are Labdanum, Melted Wax and Burning Church Incense; base notes are Extinguished Candle and Hot Musk.
impressions: Overall: Purchased 9/20/2026 after the paper test proved more wearable and compelling than expected. Smoky dry wood/fireplace, burnt embers and candle/incense atmosphere without tipping into the harshness of A City on Fire. A little sweet on the open but not as enduringly sweet as Blackmail. Really great fragrance. It's eating a cherry pie in church.

notes: Strawberry-milk accord, cardamom, iris, jasmine, white oud, vanilla and sandalwood.
impressions:
Got the 10ML extrait and I swooned--the lactonic strawberry to oud transition is tangy and fun and not as serious as the bigger oud/spice/rose bombs.
10 mL extrait received (confirmed October 15, 2026).

notes: Lily-of-the-valley (muguet); green, fresh, white-floral, lightly soapy/sweet.
impressions: Overall: I like this soliflore.

notes: Jinjang (aged soy sauce), charcoal, soybean; ylang-ylang, jasmine, jasmine sambac; Geogaia/petrichor effect, styrax, opoponax, myrrh, cistus.
impressions:
Overall: Purchased 9/20/2026. A genuinely unusual savory-smoky gourmand architecture: fermented soybean/jinjang and charcoal are softened by florals and resin rather than becoming food-like.
Performance: Purchased after store testing; full-wear notes TBD.

notes: Apricot/fruit/rosewood/rose/muguet/lemon; carnation, tuberose, cardamom, heliotrope, narcissus, orange blossom, jasmine/lily; amber, sandalwood, vanilla, opoponax, benzoin, civet, cedar, vetiver, musk.
impressions: Inherited from mother 10/3/2026. 0.12 fl oz / 3.7 ml 'Perfume' miniature; likely 1990s/original-era formulation. Not yet fully tested.

notes: Elemi/citrus, iris, cashmere wood; vanilla, benzoin, ambergris, sandalwood, leather, musk.
impressions: Received 10/3/2026 as the later formulation comparison bottle. Not yet fully tested; compare directly with the older UNUM version.

notes: Gardenia, ylang-ylang, mirabilis; rose, violet, geranium; plum, musk, woody notes.
Top: saffron, black currant; heart: rose; base: amber, patchouli. Accords: warm spicy, fruity, amber, woody, rose, metallic.
impressions: Purchased in Paterson Oct 17, 2026 as part of Gissah Valley 3 × 50 ml set. Enjoyed in-store; individual wear test pending.

notes: Top: Sicilian bergamot, pink pepper, davana; heart: oud, white amber, rosemary; base: leather, musk, Haitian vetiver. Accords: aromatic, oud, leather, fresh spicy, animalic.
impressions: Purchased in Paterson Oct 17, 2026 as part of Gissah Valley 3 × 50 ml set. Enjoyed in-store; individual wear test pending.

notes: Top: incense, raspberry, apricot; heart: cotton candy, guaiac wood, sandalwood; base: amberwood, tonka, patchouli. Accords: woody, amber, sweet, smoky, balsamic.
impressions: Purchased in Paterson Oct 17, 2026 as part of Gissah Valley 3 × 50 ml set. Enjoyed in-store; individual wear test pending.

notes: Lemon, bergamot, grapefruit, lychee, tropical/exotic flowers, warm sand; bright citrus-floral aquatic.
impressions: Overall: Citrusy, summery, very LA at the beach, really lovely but fades out too quickly.

notes: Rose, warm spice and amber/vanilla accents.
impressions:
5 mL decant received October 15, 2026. Previously recorded as in transit.
5 mL received October 15, 2026.

notes: Custom blend; composition not documented in public sources.
impressions: Overall: One-of-a kind by me--tomato, honey notes. It is strange but fresh.

notes: Top: frankincense, pink pepper, saffron; heart: cardamom, geranium, jasmine, rose; base: oakmoss, oud, patchouli, sandalwood, vanilla, vetiver.
impressions: 10 ml decant purchased in Paterson Oct 17, 2026. Outrageous, strongly peppery opening; most differentiating fragrance smelled all day. Loved opening; evaluate drydown.

notes: Top: frankincense, hazelnut, orris, pear, pink pepper; heart: jasmine sambac, jasmine, saffron, rose, osmanthus; base: sandalwood, ambrette, citrus, ambergris, oud, vanilla. Accords: woody, white floral, warm spicy, amber, nutty.
impressions: 10 ml decant purchased in Paterson Oct 17, 2026. Guidance-family pear/hazelnut/incense composition; test against owned Guidance and Guidance 46. It's a moodier, oud-ier version of Guidance. Open is very similar.

notes: Choya nakh / roasted seashell-char effect; smoke; sandalwood base
impressions:
Overall: Arrived 9/26/2026. Excellent solo and as a layering tool: a clear charred/smoky roasted-shell effect over a sandalwood base. Immediately useful because it makes the choya nakh signature recognizable in other compositions.
Wear evolution: Smoky, charred and mineral from the outset; the shell-roast effect stays legible rather than becoming generic wood.
Performance: Oil/attar wear; layering performance promising. Full solo longevity TBD.

notes: Traditional Kannauj attar: baked clay/earth distilled into sandalwood oil. Petrichor, wet earth, mineral clay, faint smoke, creamy sandalwood.
impressions: Received by 10/3/2026. Owned but not yet fully tested. Purchased as a literal natural-material calibration for petrichor/wet-earth/mineral-clay effects rather than another conceptual rain fragrance. Full spray/wear notes TBD.

notes: Oud, vanilla, amber, sandalwood, raspberry, plum, musk. Smoky dark-fruit amber/oud.
impressions: Purchased 10/3/2026 after repeated paper/drydown testing. Huge smoke with dark fruit and woods; repeatedly compelling and clearly beats lighter smoke options tested the same day.

notes: Powerful salty mineral marine/aquatic.
impressions:
Ameer 10/13: LOVED it; salty, forceful mineral marine close to Seashell and Turkuaz. Bought 10 mL decant and subsequently a full bottle cheaply (per Ameer visit notes). Full bottle receipt still unconfirmed.
10 mL decant received October 15, 2026. Separately purchased full bottle: receipt not confirmed.
10/22/2026: Full bottle received; I now have both the 10 mL and the full bottle. Wore it from the 10 mL this morning: outstanding, real beast mode. Smells very similar to Megamare. Beautiful gentle finish after many, many hours. Must be careful not to overspray.

notes: Pineapple, fruity sweetness, soft powdery woody drydown (per skin impression).
impressions:
10/13: fun, novel pineapple opening; sharp initially, softens and turns powdery. Bought 10 mL; test long wear.
10 mL decant received October 15, 2026.

notes: Saffron, cinnamon, cardamom, oud, Turkish rose, patchouli, amber, leather, sandalwood, labdanum.
impressions: Full bottle received October 13, 2026 (Mercari). Very positive on arrival; it wears lovely. Moderately heavy but not beast, it's a nice in-between arabian style frag, I can feel the saffron and spice and I really like it.

notes: Passion fruit, oud, saffron, rose, leather, amber.
impressions:
5 mL decant received October 15, 2026. Previously recorded as in transit.
5 mL received October 15, 2026.

notes: Saffron, ginger, Sicilian mandarin, Sicilian bergamot; Moroccan rose, Egyptian jasmine, amberwood, Indonesian patchouli; sandalwood, oakmoss, white musk, Madagascar vanilla.
impressions: Full bottle received (confirmed October 12, 2026). It was a nice wear, not super heavy but again--the saffron note. I seem to go crazy for it. It feels lower stakes and I could see burning through it more since I like it, it doesn't overwhelm, it's soft on the drydown and it wasn't crazy expensive.

notes: Saffron, musky amber, incense; extrait formulation.
impressions:
5 mL decant received October 15, 2026.
10/20/2026 wear: SHARP. Very neat, but so sharp it feels almost synthetic. Intense and long-lasting; few sprays are needed. I enjoy it, but feel it needs a floral or amber layer to soften the edge. Probably would not repurchase after using what I have. But this is very well done for the effect--perfume for robots.

notes: Top notes are Saffron and Bergamot; middle notes are Agarwood (Oud) and Bulgarian Rose; base notes are Tonka Bean, Sugar Cane, Amber, White Musk and Oakmoss.
impressions: Ordered online for sale barely used. A fun, oud/rose with a sharpness on the back end that I really like. An easy, lower pressure oud wear, if that makes sense. The base notes do mellow it out.

notes: Mushroom/fungal, earthy, green-mossy and solvent-like facets; deliberately strange, dense and organic.
impressions:
Overall: Bottle arrived 9/30/2026 and the skin test is a huge success. Extremely mushroomy, crazy and amazing. On skin it sits one hair's breadth short of obnoxious, but instead of tipping over it becomes profoundly earthy: 'I am in the earth, I am OF the earth.' The fungal/soil wrongness is the point, not a flaw.
Wear evolution: Immediate mushroom/fungal earthiness with a confrontational edge; on skin the aggression resolves into immersive damp-earth materiality rather than becoming merely harsh.

notes: Artemisia, green notes, mint, bergamot, peach; carnation, patchouli, orris, rose, cedar, ylang-ylang, jasmine; oakmoss, leather, sandalwood, musk, amber.
impressions: Overall: OMG so so unique and eccentric and bright with a touch of mint--not a toothpaste mint. Just really statement. Trippy chypre. So, so special and like nothing else I have. Not always in the mood but this one is on the short list. The parfum has more depth and a less confrontational opening but they are all amazing.

notes: Lilac, hyacinth, heliotrope, magnolia petals, ylang-ylang, nectarine; fresh green floral with powdery sweetness.
impressions: Overall: I like certain soliflores, and Lilac is among my favorites.

notes: Nutmeg, saffron, coriander; cypriol/nagarmotha; vanilla, sandalwood, cedar.
Peppermint, black pepper; violet leaf, clary sage; palo santo, cypress, cypriol.
Juniper, cardamom, fig leaf, bergamot, grapefruit; fig tree, lavender, black tea, geranium; vanilla, woods, cedar, ambergris, musk, oakmoss.
impressions:
Overall: A weird edge case in the collection: I have always found it very wearable, unisex and odd. The opening is fairly bright and takes me a second to calibrate to, which is part of its character.
Wear evolution: Fairly bright opening; takes a moment of recalibration rather than reading as immediately familiar. → Once calibrated, it reads as wearable, unisex and pleasantly odd.

notes: Quince, rose water, saffron, coriander, carrot seed; rose, peony, magnolia, freesia; honey, white musk, cedar, sandalwood, benzoin, tonka.
impressions: Overall: Floral, heavy, feels very Indian, opluent. Feminine, among the most so in my collection and while it is very different that Guidance, it has that same fruity, suck-you-in quality. It lasts but it does not dominate like NdP or NY Oud.

notes: Top notes are Sea water, Ozonic notes, Saffron and Artemisia; middle notes are Seaweed, Cassis and Turkish Rose; base notes are Oakmoss, Ambroxan and Amber.
impressions: Overall: Blew my little mind. It invades and hangs around forever--artemis to blame! Amazing, marine, but wilder. Sophisticated marine + Middle Eastern; paper can feel strident, but skin softened it and kept pulling me back. Wear evolution: SKIN TESTED AND LOVED IT. → the artemnesia is LOUD! 10/8/2026 extended skin wear: extraordinary persistent sharp marine minerality with metallic and convincing amberg ris-like depth; emphatically NOT an Aqua Velva / conventional masculine aquatic effect. Repeatedly drawn back to smell arm hours later. Drydown remains intensely satisfying; longevity is a major strength. Strong owned-collection benchmark for magnetic, lasting scent. I will likely burn through this.

notes: Ginger oil, cinnamon bark, cypriol heart, orris concrete, olibanum hyperabsolute, Cedramber.
impressions:
Overall: Travel size purchased 9/20/2026. Woody-spicy/resinous with a bright ginger-cinnamon lift and an olibanum/cedramber base; bought as a wearable wood/incense lane rather than another heavy oud. The hinoki/cypress/incense profile stays soft rather than maximalist, but the material quality and calm woody atmosphere are compelling enough that low projection does not bother me. 
Wear evolution: Gentle foresty hinoki/cypress, crisp green wood and incense; immediately beautiful on skin. → Stays soft, woody and meditative with a sharper dry facet underneath; never becomes heavy. Performance: Low projection; I spray generously. Despite the quiet wear, the scent itself is a Love and full-bottle worthy. A good gentle bedtime scent.

notes: Cypress, Peruvian pepper/Shinus molle, white thyme, clove leaf, olibanum oil and absolute, Texas cedar, moss, Cashmeran.
impressions: Overall: Travel size purchased 9/20/2026; full wear 9/24/2026. Fabulous on skin: gentle, foresty and beautifully composed.

notes: Pure agarwood (oud); woody, balsamic, leathery, animalic, smoky/medicinal facets can vary markedly by batch and origin.
impressions: Overall: OMG. Cornerstone oud blend--can be worn alone or as a base. This is signature for me. Not as barnyardy as other samples I have, so it is a bit more versatile. Can

notes: Pure agarwood (oud); woody, balsamic, leathery, animalic, smoky and medicinal facets vary by batch and origin.
impressions: Overall: Sibling to Denaoud XX A, my cornerstone 1/Love — pure agarwood with woody, balsamic, leathery, animalic and smoky/medicinal facets that vary by batch.

notes: Ozonic and marine notes, bergamot, grapefruit, lemon, mandarin, petitgrain; juniper, mint, Moroccan artemisia, myrtle; balsam fir, oakmoss, driftwood, patchouli, suede.
impressions:
Overall: Travel size purchased 9/20/2026. Fresh aquatic but with enough dark green/woody structure to avoid a generic blue-fragrance effect; a practical marine lane with depth. Final strip re-check 9/25: gorgeous, intensely marine and seashell-like, very close to the WAMAQ Seashell pleasure center. Extremely glad I bought it.
Wear evolution: Deep drydown stayed unmistakably marine, dry and seashell-like rather than turning generic blue.
Performance: PURCHASE VALIDATED; strong marine Love.

notes: Custom clone inspired by Amouage Decision. Reference fragrance notes only; SWID formula not verified.
impressions: 50 ml custom Amouage Decision clone purchased at SWID in Paterson on October 17, 2026. Smelled quite good and convincing in-store. Compare against original Decision; custom formula and exact notes unverified.

notes: Sweet patchouli; specific variant/official notes unverified.
impressions:
10/13: distinctly unusual, sweet and pleasant. Bought 10 mL. Verify exact product on vial.
10 mL decant received October 15, 2026.

notes: Orange blossom, bergamot, grapefruit and citrus; jasmine, rose, tuberose and other florals; musk, sandalwood, vetiver, spice, amber.
impressions: Overall: Very light and beachy with some depth; bought in Saint Maarten. It holds that nostalgia and it is pretty but it is not a statement perfume.

notes: Truffle, gardenia, blackcurrant, ylang-ylang, jasmine, bergamot, mandarin, Amalfi lemon; orchid, spices, gardenia, fruity notes, lotus; Mexican chocolate, patchouli, vanilla, incense, amber, sandalwood, vetiver, white musk.
impressions: This slays me. Best thing TF ever did thus far. It has that disturbing truffle open wwhich turns fruity and woody and I freaking love it.

notes: Bergamot, cardamom, olibanum; Azerbaijan rose, magnolia, seawater, salt; Haitian vetiver, patchouli, choya nakh/seashell, musk, white ambergris.
impressions: Purchased 10/3/2026 after prior successful testing. Sharp, dry, haunted marine profile; hot-sun-by-the-water rather than vacation beach. Choya nakh gives the roasted-shell/smoky-oceanic dimension. Immediate re-spray after purchase confirmed strong satisfaction. Seashell is blowing my mind; choya nakh-driven roasted-shell marine character remains a standout, strongly loved acquisition.
